description.en: Exposes chat.deepseek.com (DeepSeek Web) as an OpenAI-compatible provider for DSH: a multi-account pool with mute/expiry tracking, per-account device identity, automatic token refresh with saved credentials, streaming chat completions, and a settings section for accounts, login and usage. No API key required. Ships a host plugin and a web client UI; MIT.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版封成 OpenAI 兼容 provider：多账号池（含禁言/失效状态与到期时间）、账号级设备身份、用保存的密码自动续期 token、流式 chat completions，以及账号/登录/用量设置分区；无需 API key。含宿主插件与 Web 客户端界面，MIT。
